summary: Verified the Odoo Sync 500 regression fix. Both GET /api/admin/sync/status and POST /api/admin/sync/start now return HTTP 200 in preview. Confirm modal opens, 'Yes, Sync Now' fires POST /api/admin/sync/start (200), modal closes, 'Sync started' toast appears, button switches to 'Sync in progress…', and sync-progress panel renders. Cancel closes modal without starting. All flows pass.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="sync-info" not found on any element, though the info fields (Last lead activity / Last sync run / Next sync covers) render correctly in the UI. Likely the testid is on child cells but not on the wrapper the review request expects.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid="sync-info" on the wrapper containing the Last lead activity / Last sync run / Next sync covers cells for testability. Not a functional regression.
critical_code_review_comments: _next_since() + maxTimeMS=8000 guarding aggregations is a solid fix; sync/start no longer inherits sync_status heavy queries. Backend logs clean on start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sync regression fully resolved. Only nit: data-testid=sync-info is missing on the container in Admin.jsx; visible fields render fine.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix, sync_status ran uncapped $max aggregations + count_documents on very large prod collections (COLLSCAN -> timeout -> 500). sync_start called sync_status internally so it inherited the 500. Fix: cheap _next_since() reads last_sync settings doc for delta window; sync_status wraps every heavy op in try/except with maxTimeMS=8000 returning None/0 on failure; sync_start no longer calls sync_status. Verified via curl and UI: both endpoints 200; sync run 11 was created.
